name: std-learn-doser
description: Generic monotone-accumulation dosing instrument — the learner adds a quantity in large or small config-declared increments (or lets it auto-drip on its own inline clock) and watches an accumulated dose climb through a config-declared roster of bands/zones (thresholds, labels, colors all config), rendered as a reservoir/source vessel pair plus a dose-history trace on a canvas. Crossing into a terminal band is irreversible — done latches true and only Reset revives it. Standalone by default it renders its own control strip AND scene canvas; set showCanvas false to embed only the control strip (via @trait.<name>) beneath a composed sibling trait that owns the domain-accurate scene — see std-chem-titration for the transport-sibling shape. Behind a lab router set matchMode and it renders only when MODE_SELECTED matches.

autoDrip.description: When true, INIT/MODE_SELECTED/Reset start the drip clock adding a small increment each interval; toggle live with the Auto-dose/Pause button.
autoDrip.label: Auto Drip

bands.description: Ordered ascending roster of dose bands/zones — each carries the dose upper bound it covers, a label, a color, and whether crossing into it is terminal (irreversible; sets done true until Reset). The accumulated dose is classified into the first band whose upperBound it does not exceed, falling through to the last band beyond all bounds.
bands.label: Bands
bands.synonyms: zone, band, threshold, region, stage, phase, tier

capacity.description: Maximum total dose the source can deliver; the source vessel drains to empty and additions clamp once accumulated dose reaches this cap.
capacity.label: Capacity

dripIntervalMs.description: Milliseconds of running clock per auto-drip increment — the 32ms base tick accumulates elapsed time and adds a small step each time this interval elapses.
dripIntervalMs.label: Drip Interval (ms)

historyLength.description: Maximum points kept in the dose-history trace; older points drop off once exceeded.
historyLength.label: Dose History

matchMode.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.
matchMode.label: Match Mode

quantityLabel.description: Label used for the accumulated-quantity readout and in the narration line.
quantityLabel.label: Quantity Label

reservoirLabel.description: Label for the vessel that fills as dose accumulates.
reservoirLabel.label: Reservoir Label
reservoirLabel.synonyms: reservoir, beaker, tank, container, receiving vessel

showCanvas.description: When true (the default, standalone use) the instrument renders its own reservoir/source canvas and narration below the control strip. Set false when a domain sibling trait composes this atom via @rebindable and owns the accurate scene render itself — then only the control strip (add/drip/reset buttons) embeds via @trait.<name>, avoiding a duplicate canvas.
showCanvas.label: Show Canvas

sourceColor.description: Fill color for the source vessel.
sourceColor.label: Source Color

sourceLabel.description: Label for the vessel that drains as dose is delivered from it.
sourceLabel.label: Source Label

stepLarge.description: Quantity added per press of the coarse add button.
stepLarge.label: Large Step

stepSmall.description: Quantity added per press of the fine add button, and per auto-drip tick — for precise control near a band boundary.
stepSmall.label: Small Step

unit.description: Unit suffix appended to the step-size button labels (e.g. "mL", "mg", "units"); empty means no unit shown.
unit.label: Unit

zoneReadoutLabel.description: Label used for the current-band readout row.
zoneReadoutLabel.label: Zone Readout Label

emits.description: Fires after every dose increase — from the small/large add buttons or an auto-drip tick — with the accumulated dose and its classified band. A composed sibling trait transitions on it to recompute a domain-specific response (e.g. a chemistry pH curve) and repaint the scene it owns. A harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
emits.synonyms: dose added, increment, add, drip, titrant added, quantity added

emits.description: Fires on Reset after the dose, band, and done flag re-zero. A composed sibling trait reseeds its own domain state from config on it. A harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.

Fires on INIT/MODE_SELECTED/auto-drip toggle with the transport-level state — running flag, dose, current band, done — so a composed sibling trait can repaint its own shell. A harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
Fired once when the dose crosses into a terminal band and latches done — the standard learning completion broadcast a celebration/progression sibling (fx cues, badges) rides.
emits.synonyms: round complete, finished, done, completion, terminal band

events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.
events.name: Mode Selected
